description: Run dotnet build and return structured diagnostics with file, line, column, message, and error code. Much more compact than raw MSBuild output. Warnings are omitted by default; pass includeWarnings:true (or detailLevel:'full') to include them.

detailLevel.description: Item preset: summary 20, normal 100, full (default; also skips the response budget)

includeWarnings.description: Include warnings in the response (default: errors only, even on a successful build)

project.description: Path to .csproj or .sln file (default: auto-detected in cwd)

name: dotnet_build
title: Build (structured)
